faqs.a:
If any member shall become physically or mentally disabled, as to render it impossible
               for such member to perform his duties, the member shall be eligible to receive permanent
               disability retirement pay in that amount provided for under
section 86-151
. But in no event shall the disability benefit received be less than 50 percent of
               the employee's final base pay.
(Code 1960, § 19-11(C); Code 1981, § 26-80)
